necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91) and reports persistent episodes of palpitations (R00.2) that interfere with daily activities. To further characterize the arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered for extended ambulatory assessment. This service is medically necessary to address the specific clinical indication of correlating symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances as documented in the case facts.
